name: mcp-server-matrix
description: MCP server for Matrix messaging and room management
long_description: Interact with Matrix homeservers over stdio MCP. Send and read messages, manage rooms, invite users, resolve aliases, and inspect room state through a single local server.

matrixHomeserver.title: Homeserver URL
matrixHomeserver.description: Matrix homeserver URL, for example https://matrix.org.

matrixUser.title: Matrix user ID
matrixUser.description: Full Matrix user ID, for example @bot:example.com.

matrixPassword.title: Password
matrixPassword.description: Account password. Provide this or an access token.

matrixAccessToken.title: Access token
matrixAccessToken.description: Account access token. Provide this or a password.

matrixStorePath.title: Store path
matrixStorePath.description: Optional path for the nio session store.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a room.

tools.name: send_html
tools.description: Send an HTML-formatted message to a room.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent room messages with optional date filters and pagination.

tools.name: get_room_info
tools.description: Get room details including name, topic, members, and encryption status.

tools.name: get_room_members
tools.description: List joined members with display names and avatars.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join a room by ID or alias.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a new room with optional invites.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Invite a user to a room.

tools.name: send_reaction
tools.description: React to a message with an emoji.

tools.name: resolve_alias
tools.description: Resolve a Matrix room alias to a room ID.
